# archestra_knowledge_base (Resource)

A knowledge base groups documents and connectors that agents can search over.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A knowledge base groups documents that agents can search over.
# Attach to an `archestra_agent` via its `knowledge_base_ids`
# attribute.
#
# Prerequisites: a KB only returns results once
# `archestra_organization_settings` has `embedding_chat_api_key_id` +
# `embedding_model` and `reranker_chat_api_key_id` + `reranker_model`
# configured. Creation succeeds without them (mirrors the UI), but
# downstream searches stay empty.
#
# To clear an existing description on a subsequent apply, omit the
# attribute — the merge-patch then sends an explicit null.

resource "archestra_knowledge_base" "support_docs" {
  name        = "Support Docs"
  description = "Public KB articles, runbooks, and SOPs used by the customer support agent."
}

# Minimal — only `name` is required.
resource "archestra_knowledge_base" "internal_wiki" {
  name = "Internal Wiki"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the knowledge base.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Knowledge-base labels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `permissions` (Attributes Set) Additional direct sharing grants on this object. Applied atomically on creation and reconciled in place thereafter. Omit to preserve current grants; set [] to clear additional grants. The owner's existing grant is preserved automatically; inherited access and ownership remain managed by Archestra. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `created_by` (String) Creator identity metadata as JSON.
- `created_by_service_account_id` (String) Service account that created the knowledge base.
- `deleted_at` (String) Soft-deletion timestamp, when applicable.
- `id` (String) Knowledge base identifier.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status managed by the backend.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).

### Nested Schema for `labels`

Required:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `actions` (Set of String) Actions granted to the principal.
- `subject_id` (String) Principal ID; use * for the organization principal.
- `subject_type` (String) Principal type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_knowledge_base.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
